messages.subject: Gabrielle | MENA Executive | Government Affairs, ESG, Industrial & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Gabrielle,

Your MENA executive-search work across director and C-suite mandates, including Industrial, Logistics Infrastructure, Public Sector and Government, makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior Gulf-region roles where institutional relationships, responsible growth and country-facing execution sit close to business strategy.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My work requires direct engagement with ministries, regulators, communities and internal technical functions, alongside stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness. Earlier experience in regulated financial services adds another dimension to my governance background.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am open to wider MENA expatriate and regional assignments.

I have attached a Boyden MENA-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
